title: Pre-Submission Checklist
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: A college-by-college review of your Common App application before you press Submit, so common errors are caught first.

learningObjectives: Students will execute a structured pre-submission review of a Common App application for one college, checking every section and college-specific requirement before submitting.
prerequisites: Chapter 12: Filling Out the Common App and Coalition App

controls: Show only unchecked and Reset buttons

keyQuestions: Why does selecting the wrong round matter so much?
Why read the PDF preview instead of the form?
What goes wrong if your counselor isn't assigned before you submit?
commonMisconceptions: The Common App catches every error before you submit.
Recommenders are assigned automatically to every college.
assessmentOpportunities: Students complete the checklist for one real or practice application and name the item they almost missed.
